name: MicroCS
description: C# scripting engine and firmware runtime for microcontrollers: REPL, filesystem, scheduler, GPIO/UART/I2C/SPI/ADC/DAC/PWM/Timer/I2S/QSPI/CAN classes. Runs on ESP32, STM32, RP2040/RP2350, nRF, SAMD and any Cortex-M or RISC-V MCU.
keywords: csharp, c#, scripting, interpreter, repl, vm, embedded, esp32, stm32, rp2040
